acceptance_gate_results.principle: All saved native bytes must replay without mismatch.
The audit needs sixteen groups, 128 claims, three arms, and 672 calls.
Uncertainty must resample groups because claims share source compilation.
Each fixed corruption must fail closed before promotion.
Compiled source spans must point back to the saved document bytes.
A failed shared compilation must remain visible on all four dependent claims.
Labels must enter only through the scorer reader after replay.
Fresh and reused predictions must match exactly.
No claim may use a prior source version after revision.
The paired lower bound must be no worse than minus two points.
The paired lower bound must be no worse than minus two points.
Reuse must not add empirical false accepts against direct.
Cold full cost needs a group-paired lower speedup of at least 1.5.
Reuse must save full cost after initialization.
Reuse must also save cost after initialization is removed.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Actual executable local model identities; keep historical models in hashed sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each completeness and value check names expected, observed, passed and principle.
field_principles.audit_reconstruction: Account for raw bytes, rows, hashes and differences without importing headlines.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured monotonic elapsed and disjoint phase spans, including failures and initialization.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host is host; identify actual GPU/native/device execution separately.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here while consumer values remain ordinary top-level values.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names the upstream, field, observed value and expected value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Complete findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_; state the actual finding.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for actual computation; never infer from intended task.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Full generation60s, bounded10s, load-only2s, or actual no-LLM class; never pad elapsed time.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted/completed/failed loads and generation; retain in-flight events on timeout.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any actual attempted model load or generation, including failed and unusable work.
field_principles.paired_group_intervals: Keep units, seed, draw count, estimates, bounds and denominators for each criterion.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Hash actual inputs, authority boundaries, resource ownership and failed checks.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze development and independent evaluation seeds before observing outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, config, inputs, model identity if any and immutable raw evidence.
field_principles.reuse_audit_complete_score: One means raw reduction and every fixed corruption control finished.
field_principles.reuse_promotion_score: One requires every safety, parity, full-cost, and authority gate.
field_principles.rows: Every comparative unit and arm keeps metric, cost, error, abstention and censoring.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260914, real UTC start/end and monotonic timing.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Keep planned, attempted, complete and censored units plus the frozen stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact; retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Keep exact producer identities, terminal classes, retirement and quarantine state.
field_principles.source_integrity_control_rows: Keep each mutation, expected rejection, observed finding and disposition.
field_principles.status: Use a terminal complete or blocked record; unfinished own work belongs in separate checkpoints.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Keep command, exit code, elapsed time and log hash, including failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use positive, circular_positive, null, blocked, disqualified, or partial only.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared verifier authority; same-authority mechanics are not learned correctness.

limitations: Sixteen source groups do not support rare-event assurance.
The frozen construction authority makes correctness oracle-shared.
Cached-token counters are transport evidence and are not wall-time savings.

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: audit the frozen 16 groups and 672 calls once; do not retry, tune, add, or remove rows
